cohort: 5,606 women with singleton, vertex, term gestation who presented at ≤ 6 cm of cervical dilatation following a spontaneous labour onset that resulted in a vaginal birth with no adverse birth outcomes
finding: Cervical dilatation during labor in the slowest-yet-normal women can progress more slowly than the widely accepted benchmark of 1 cm/hour, irrespective of parity.
mod_finding: Exclusion of women with augmented labors from the study population resulted in slightly faster labor progression patterns.
